北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大体感冷，多穿衣物防感冒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and feels cold, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力大，早晚温差明显，注意保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is windy with a noticeable day-night temperature difference, stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗宜人，早晚凉意，别忘了添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant, but cool in mornings and evenings, remember to add layers.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，短袖加薄外套，舒适出行。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and bright, a T-shirt with a light jacket will keep you comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗温暖，早晚微凉，记得备件薄外套。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm, slightly cool in mornings and evenings, keep a light jacket handy.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州风力不小，体感偏凉，多穿点哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is quite windy and feels cool, dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京天气阴沉，体感寒冷，注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and feels chilly, pay attention to wind protection and staying warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阳光正好，气温适宜，尽情享受吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu has perfect sunshine and comfortable temperatures, enjoy it!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，风力较大，体感偏凉，注意保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and quite windy, feels cool, remember to stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，注意补水，早晚温差大。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and dry, remember to hydrate, and mind the large day-night temperature difference.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，外出戴口罩，注意呼吸健康。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, wear a mask when going out, and take care of your respiratory health.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，全副武装出门，谨防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, bundle up completely when going out to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳寒冷，风力不小，多穿保暖衣物哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cold and quite windy, wear more warm clothes.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云宜人，注意早晚温差，舒适出行。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and pleasant, mind the day-night temperature difference for comfortable outings.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗有风，体感稍凉，小心着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and windy, feels a bit cool, be careful not to catch a cold.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风大体感冷，多穿衣物，别冻着了！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is windy and feels cold, wear more clothes, don't get frozen!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 6级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连寒冷风大，注意防风保暖，小心感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cold and windy, stay warm and protected from the wind, watch out for colds.
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级
